if: input tax credit is claimed on an invoice or debit note pertaining to financial year 2017-18, 2018-19, 2019-20 or 2020-21
the return under section 39 carrying the claim was filed up to the thirtieth day of November, 2021
then: CONFLICT — one locally held source allows the credit notwithstanding the s.16(4) time bar; the other does not contain the sub-section at all. Neither is adopted here
note: Absent from the primary source. The IndiaCode consolidation carries it and footnotes it as inserted by Act 15 of 2024 with retrospective effect from 1-07-2017. A retrospective relief of this kind materially changes whether a historic credit was time-barred, which is exactly why it is recorded and not resolved.

evidence.section: CGST Act s.16(5) (source B, IndiaCode consolidation)
evidence.quote: Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (4), in respect of an invoice or debit note for supply of goods or services or both pertaining to the Financial Years 2017-18, 2018-19, 2019-20 and 2020-21, the registered person shall be entitled to take input tax credit in any return under section 39 which is filed up to the thirtieth day of November, 2021.

evidence.section: CGST Act s.16(4), closing words (source A, Act as updated 31-08-2021)
evidence.quote: debit note pertains or furnishing of the relevant annual return, whichever is earlier.
evidence.extraction_note: Cited to show where source A ends section 16: at sub-section (4). There is no sub-section (5) or (6) in that source.
